subject: 浏阳文庙 · 大成殿正面与月台
name: 浏阳文庙
yearNote: 北宋县令杨时始建，明弘治十八年（1505）迁县城西隅，清嘉庆二十三年（1818）迁至今址，道光二十三年（1843）重建，现存建筑群即此后遗构。年表取1843年。
coordinate_source: Wikidata Q11148323（浏阳文庙）P625 坐标 28.1475, 113.6285，文庙本体近似坐标，非本项目测绘；地图显示点新建 hu_liuyang。
lede: 浏阳文庙藏在浏阳一中的校园里：北宋始建，清嘉庆二十三年（1818）迁至今址、道光二十三年（1843）重建，仿曲阜孔庙的宫殿式格局保存完整，有“江南第一文庙”之称。大成殿重檐歇山、黄绿琉璃瓦，石柱上雕龙的斜撑托起深远的下檐，殿前月台正中铺着盘龙御路。
facts: 北宋县令杨时始建，明弘治十八年（1505）迁县城西隅，清嘉庆二十三年（1818）迁今址，道光二十三年（1843）重建；占地六千余平方米，坐北朝南，仿曲阜孔庙宫殿式。
大成殿重檐歇山顶，黄绿琉璃瓦，正脊中央立宝顶、两端鸱吻；前檐六根石柱分五间，中间一间最宽，柱头雕龙形斜撑，格扇门饰圆形团花格心（据照片）。
殿前月台围石栏，正中御路雕龙，两侧石阶各一道；道光九年（1829）邱之稑重修祭孔古乐，“浏阳文庙祭孔音乐”2014年列入国家级非遗；2013年列第七批国保。

清 · 1843年重建
structure_checkpoints: 大成殿两重檐：上檐歇山，正脊中央一座葫芦形宝顶、两端鸱吻，垂脊端部有小兽；上层殿身为一排连续的木格栅板，正中嵌竖匾（留白）；下檐为宽大的单坡出檐，檐下一道深色额枋。
下檐由六根方形石柱分成五间（裁图 liuyang_cols 可数清六柱）：中间一间最宽（约为相邻间的一倍半以上），两端间最窄；柱头上部各有一对雕龙形的斜撑（雀替）；柱身有阴刻对联（留白）。
各间均为格扇门：中间一间四扇（照片中敞开），其余各间格扇密排，格心为圆形团花与万字纹，裙板有浮雕；格扇以线条勾勒，不作黑色填充。
殿前月台：三面围石栏杆（回纹栏板），正中一块盘龙御路石，御路两侧各一道石阶，月台前角各一只石狮（可保留为小剪影或去除）；两侧翘角的钟鼓亭与两庑不画，前景铁树盆与香炉去除。
material_observations: 屋面黄绿色琉璃瓦（黄瓦为主、绿色剪边，瓦面带苔），脊饰灰黑；木构格扇与檐柱间板壁深褐近黑，上层格栅板嵌金色团花；石柱浅灰；月台与栏杆浅灰石材，御路石灰白。

prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK line drawing on a perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) background. Use confident fine contours and a few finer internal structural lines. All unmarked surfaces inside and outside the drawing remain pure white; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, broad grey shading, crosshatching, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, gold, halo, cast shadow or checkerboard. The white canvas will be removed later by a script; draw only the ink strokes and keep all other regions uniformly white.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.

SUBJECT: the Dacheng Hall of Liuyang Confucian Temple with its front terrace, seen straight-on (Image 2 wide view; Image 3 close-up for columns and doors). Draw a DOUBLE-EAVE hip-and-gable hall: the upper roof with a central gourd finial and ridge-end ornaments, below it an upper wall band of continuous lattice panels with a blank vertical plaque at centre, then a broad lower eave. The lower eave is carried by SIX square stone columns making FIVE bays—the middle bay clearly the widest, the two end bays narrowest; each column top has a pair of carved dragon-shaped brackets; the columns bear blank couplet strips. Every bay is filled with lattice doors drawn in outline (the central doors open). In front, a raised stone terrace with a fretwork balustrade on three sides, a carved dragon ramp stone at the centre and one flight of steps on each side of it; a small lion on each front corner may be kept as a simple outline. Exclude the two pavilions at the sides, the side galleries, potted plants and incense burners.
Orientation: landscape 1536×1024.
